card.name: Section numbers in highlight cross-references
card.fires_on: The section number digit inside parenthetical cross-references like ( 5.1 , 7.2 ) or ( 4 ) in the Highlights of drug labels. It fires on the digit that names the label section, whether it comes first or after a comma or a decimal point.

modes.label: Lone section number
modes.description: A single digit in brackets after a contraindication or warning statement.

modes.label: Section number in a list
modes.description: The main section digit in a reference with several sections, often after a comma.

modes.label: Subsection digit
modes.description: The digit after the decimal point in a dosing section reference.

card.plain: It marks the section number in the small reference brackets that point from a label's summary to its full sections.
